human_understanding_delta: For zeros on a circle the whole profile of |g| along the radius towards a zero is an explicit function of the chord distances from that zero alone, and in the palindromic variable y = t + 1/t the spoke-containment condition becomes a Chebyshev-type comparison outside [-2,2]. Summed over the n radii the profile telescopes to an exact all-order identity whose deficit is the nonnegative series sum_m |s_m|^2 t^m / m, so at every radius at least one spoke is inside the lemniscate; this replaces the recorded first-order near-Fekete balance identity by an unconditional one. The radial derivative admits the sharp per-term bound 1/(1+t), giving the sharp monotonicity threshold (n-2)/n and the sharp per-radius ceiling (1-t)(1+t)^{n-1}. Finally the two endpoint families of the Form A-cut reduction do not suffice even in disjunction and even with all root chords admitted, already inside the concyclic subfamily and already at the first open degree, so the interior hub is necessary rather than convenient.
